title: Run a 30-minute weekly retro for a team of eight
variant: Playbook as a timeline with minute marks and a script
prompt: How do I run a 30-minute weekly retro for a team of eight that has never done one?
note: A playbook rather than a tutorial: tight sans, the goal as a small card beside the title, and the steps as a timeline with monospace minute marks in a left column and the script on the right, with the words to say out loud in italic quotation blocks so stage directions and lines are told apart at a glance. The three pitfalls sit at the minute where a first retro goes wrong, variations are three parallel columns for remote, in person, and later weeks, and the done checklist carries a small progressive tally.
